title: The Break and the Work After
player_facing_question: Did Iss break the Hold, did the Hold break itself, or did the Record turn an ordinary failure into something that could no longer be contained—and what can still be repaired?
plausible_initial_belief: Iss's secret cut caused one catastrophic collapse; the copied region is either punishment or meaningless supernatural damage.
human_stake: Iss found a real future and endangered the people he wanted to free. Orin, Brann, Vaun, Mara, and the council left older failures in place. Repair must restore water, light, pressure, and a safe route without erasing responsibility.
earned_belief: The Break was multi-cause: chronic structural damage, unequal allocation and deferred maintenance, falsified warnings and delay, Iss's dangerous excavation, and Record/Dark feedback all interacted. Iss accelerated the event but neither invented the prior failures nor controls the uncanny feedback. Material systems remain repairable.
required_inference: Players must construct a causal graph distinguishing precondition, accelerator, concealment/delay, and feedback. No single culprit or supernatural explanation passes. Repair choices are derived from established engineering rules rather than UI trial-and-error.
callback: P5 service cards become repair manuals; P6 Orin/Brann/Iss evidence changes causal weight; P7 proves that edited records can predate the Break. The clean copied room first looks like a preserved original, then proves the Record copied official edits instead of living history.

consequence.minecraft: Cistern water clears, paired lamps return, the pressure bypass closes, and one safe route opens. The altered copy remains visible behind glass rather than being magically healed.
consequence.npc: Iss's remembered statement gains two annotations: SURFACE CLAIM SUPPORTED and ROUTE METHOD UNSAFE. Neither cancels the other.
consequence.copperline: The accepted plan is preserved, then gains the current group's works readback and Dob's surface-patch comparison without replacing the before state.
consequence.discord: The incident brief preserves the interacting cause model and the tested works order.

spaces.navigation: parallel lanes reconverge at causal board
spaces.affordance: three materially distinct table lanes feed one causal board rather than repeating answer stations

spaces.composition: recognizable copied office with too-clean official notices, absent personal repairs, duplicate cabinet wear, impossible timestamp plate
spaces.navigation: viewable from two accessible galleries; no answer requires entering fragile geometry
spaces.affordance: protected windows and paired descriptions mark the room as observation-only, never a hidden-click volume

spaces.job: repair water, light, pressure, and route using proven service rules

spaces.affordance: unique component silhouettes, occupied housings, and persistent state readbacks expose every repair verb

evidence.title: Lamp soot before alarm
evidence.author: Toma Rei
evidence.provenance: soot sealed beneath alarm-day paint; Toma card dated two watches earlier
evidence.content: The east circuit feathered and extinguished before the official alarm. Toma cleaned one hood, found pressure residue, and requested closure; the request was filed after the alarm in the public chronology.
evidence.clue_job: Places equipment failure and delayed filing before Iss's final cut.

evidence.title: Bird care lapse
evidence.author: Eda Pell and air watch
evidence.provenance: care cards independent of incident office; two empty relief cells
evidence.content: The warning birds showed distress during an unstaffed paired-watch gap. The official report says birds reacted after collapse; Eda's pupil note asks why class was moved before the alarm.
evidence.accessibility: no live animal distress; records and humane empty habitat carry the evidence
evidence.clue_job: Shows a practical warning failed through staffing and chronology alteration.

evidence.title: Mineralized third-bay fracture
evidence.author: Orin Hale
evidence.provenance: mineral growth crosses old fracture; fresh Iss tool marks stop short of oldest edge
evidence.content: The load-bearing fracture moved through several wet/dry cycles before the new excavation. Iss's cut reaches and widens it but cannot account for its age or the undersized brace beside it.
evidence.accessibility: texture and age observations duplicated in a labeled cross-section

evidence.title: Heat-load promise
evidence.author: Council works clerk
evidence.medium: allocation order and actual gauge history
evidence.provenance: order references Orin certificate; gauge copy independently preserved by heat works
evidence.content: The council promised to halve upper-gallery heat load before Orin's conditional certificate took effect. Actual readings remain unchanged while favored galleries receive diverted charcoal.
evidence.clue_job: Joins resource inequality to structural load rather than treating diversion as a separate scandal.

evidence.title: Eight written over nine
evidence.author: Brann Iles and unknown clerk
evidence.medium: watch plate and clean incident copy
evidence.provenance: physical ninth stroke survives beneath fill; Brann/Pell evidence confirms true relief
evidence.content: The public incident begins at eighth bell, before missing coverage and closure requests would implicate delay. The original plate and market chronology place the initiating alarm at ninth.
evidence.accessibility: stroke difference transcribed; no pixel-perfect visual dependence
evidence.clue_job: Proves official chronology was shifted to hide response time.

evidence.title: Living surface packet
evidence.author: Iss, Sella, two unnamed carriers
evidence.medium: reed, water strip, air slate, and route draft
evidence.provenance: independent dates and biological state corroborate surface recovery
evidence.content: Warm air, viable water, and living reed prove Iss's central claim: the surface had healed enough to investigate. The packet also records no structural permit, no paired watch, and no load review for his route.
evidence.accessibility: shape/text labels duplicate color; archive description available
evidence.clue_job: Forces players to preserve Iss's truth while rejecting his remedy.

evidence.title: Hidden cut roster
evidence.author: Iss and three workers
evidence.medium: private work roster with erased names
evidence.provenance: name impressions recoverable from duplicate carbon; timestamps overlap unpaired watch
evidence.content: Iss chose a small crew during the watch gap, diverted heat tools, and omitted Orin and Brann. One worker writes: He said asking would turn spring into another winter. I believed him. I still asked where the brace calculation was.
evidence.clue_job: Establishes deliberate unsafe excavation without making Iss sole cause.

evidence.title: Closure requests and late routing
evidence.author: Toma, Brann, Mara
evidence.medium: three requests sharing a delayed intake number
evidence.provenance: different offices submitted before alarm; all acquired the same later intake stamp
evidence.content: Lamp pressure, absent paired watch, and unsafe route edition were separately reported. The Record-facing copies place all three after the event, while local work copies retain earlier dates.
evidence.accessibility: version differences rendered as textual chronology
evidence.clue_job: Shows institutional delay/falsification as an interacting cause class.

evidence.title: Too-clean copied office
evidence.author: unknown; compared by Mara and Rook later
evidence.medium: altered room and baseline contact sheet
evidence.provenance: copy contains official clean editions but omits older repairs physically present before its impossible timestamp
evidence.content: At first the copied office looks like the untouched original. Comparison shows it preserves the council's corrected dates and clean manual, yet lacks Eda's stove patch and Toma's old hinge repair. It copied an official account, not a moment in physical history.
evidence.accessibility: stable contact sheet with annotated differences; no mandatory free-camera alignment
evidence.clue_job: Establishes Record feedback as selective observation, not generic corruption.

evidence.title: Copy-before-source timestamp
evidence.author: automated civic registry
evidence.medium: registry plate and cabinet growth layers
evidence.provenance: plate predates the source cabinet's final alteration; duplicate wear appears under later finish; human maintainer attribution is absent
evidence.content: The copy records a cabinet change one watch before the source cabinet was changed. The safest conclusion is not that time reversed, but that the Record participated in the feedback loop it claimed only to observe. The Dark's nature remains unresolved.
evidence.accessibility: chronology and material layers described in text
evidence.clue_job: Adds an uncanny causal class without collapsing the still-distinct Dark, Record, Watcher, and missing registrar.

conclusions.prompt: What was Iss right about, and what made his remedy unsafe?
accepted_answers: Iss was right that the surface had healed, but he cut a secret route through an already stressed bay without structural authorization or paired watch, accelerating the Break.

conclusions.prompt: What does the altered copy prove without claiming to explain the Dark?
accepted_answers: The altered room preserves official edits instead of lived history and records a change before its source, showing the Record fed back into the failure; it does not explain what the Dark is.

conclusions.prompt: File the causal graph of the Break.
accepted_answers: The Break combined chronic fracture and undersized bracing, unequal heat allocation and deferred maintenance, falsified warnings and delayed closure, Iss's unsafe secret cut as an accelerator, and Record/Dark copying feedback.

The crew restored local water, paired light, pressure control, and a safe route; repair proves the systems were material and changeable without erasing the people and institutions that caused the failure.

repairs.name: water
repairs.rule: Install only the hash/provenance-matched original filter component in its unique housing.
repairs.negative: wrong or duplicate components return atomically
repairs.visible_readback: clear lower draw, stable pressure card, WATER VERIFIED text

repairs.name: paired light
repairs.rule: Read the fixed diagnostic with the P5 lamp service card; replace the open relay rather than toggling evidence lamps.
repairs.negative: evidence panel is immutable and cannot be brute-switched
repairs.visible_readback: both coverage lamps and SHARED WATCH VERIFIED

repairs.name: pressure
repairs.rule: Use the fixed gauge rule to identify line four's open bypass, then close the physical service wheel at the mapped line.
repairs.negative: other wheels are labeled isolation valves and refuse the mismatched diagnosis
repairs.visible_readback: return gauge zero, outlet within tolerance, BYPASS CLOSED

repairs.name: safe route
repairs.rule: Follow the supplied service diagram to inspect the replaced brace and open the bounded staff route; no coordinate-perfect block trace.
repairs.negative: route remains closed until water/light/pressure local receipts exist, never until source clicks exist
repairs.visible_readback: staff gate opens, integration console lists four stable receipts

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: Iss caused the Break and every earlier problem was incidental.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The board accepts Iss's unsafe cut as an accelerator, then returns mineralized fracture, undersized brace, pre-cut outage, allocation load, and altered closure requests.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: Iss was a whistleblower framed by the council and bears no responsibility.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The surface claim is marked TRUE-BUT-NOT-THE-DOOR. The hidden roster, missing authorization, diverted tools, and stressed-bay route still require an agency finding.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: The Dark supernaturally caused everything, so human chronology is irrelevant.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: Record feedback is retained as a cause class, but it does not explain preexisting material damage, supply choices, edited times, or the success of physical repair.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: Successful repair proves the official story was basically correct.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The works console confirms the repairs and returns the causal brief: material agency does not erase falsification, inequality, or unsafe excavation.

hints.H0: Build four incident lanes before touching the works floor: chronology, structure/load, surface/route, and copied-space feedback.
hints.H1: For each claim, label evidence PREEXISTING, ACCELERATOR, CONCEALMENT/DELAY, or FEEDBACK.
hints.H2: A complete graph needs a human/material precondition, an institutional choice, Iss's route, and the Record anomaly. None replaces another.
hints.H3: Use pre-alarm soot and bird gap; mineralized fracture and unfulfilled load promise; living surface plus hidden cut; shifted timestamps; and the copy-before-source office. Then apply the proven service rules to water, light, pressure, and route.

runtime.replay: before/after archive plus stable causal graph and repair receipts
runtime.restart: all repairs and world changes rebuild from local journal without duplication
runtime.crash: durable receipt precedes visual world change; incomplete projection resumes
runtime.outage: all four repairs complete locally; remote projections queue and cannot reopen or override physical state

novelty_comparison: P7 proves a human legal/forensic case through custody. P8 expands into a causal graph and then changes the world through engineering. The uncanny evidence complicates rather than replaces material causation.
cold_theory_paths: Iss culprit -> Iss partly right -> Iss accelerator among causes
cursed copy -> official-record copy -> active feedback system
broken ruin -> repairable infrastructure -> repair without absolution
